brief:
The relationship between Israel and the United Nations has deteriorated to unprecedented levels, Middle East Eye reported, as the genocide in Gaza intensifies existing tensions between the two parties. The conflict has strained diplomatic channels and deepened divisions that were already fraught before the recent escalation in violence and humanitarian crisis.

The deterioration reflects broader disputes over humanitarian access, accountability mechanisms, and competing narratives surrounding events in Gaza. Previous disagreements over UN resolutions, independent investigations, and official statements have compounded the current rupture. The tensions underscore fundamental differences over how the international body should respond to the situation unfolding in Palestinian territories.

title: Israel-UN relations hit historic low amid Gaza genocide
